{{Quote|Two basic sliders at one great price.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Talus and Tralus slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
The  '''Talus and Tralus slider''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] offered at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner's sliders were inspired by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] travels around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The meal was inspired<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the twin worlds [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]<ref name="">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> and consisted of two basic [[slider]]s for the price of 9.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner's basic sliders included the [[Coruscant slider]], the [[Socorro slider]], the [[Zeltros slider]], the [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]], the [[Khomm slider]], and the [[Giju slider]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talus and Tralus sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
